name: Narao (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Narao town emblem in white: a ring of two curved strokes with winged ends enclosing a stylised character.
history: Flag of the former town of Narao in Nagasaki Prefecture, dissolved on 2004-08-01.

features.role: Narao town emblem — a ring of two curved strokes with winged ends enclosing a stylised character
